outcome: persistent noncyclical pelvic pain despite hormonal treatment (VAS score > 30)
cohort: The study examined 164 patients with histopathologically confirmed deep infiltrating endometriosis (DE) and/or ovarian endometrioma (OV) who received preoperative hormonal treatment.
finding: Ovarian endometrioma, noncyclical chronic pelvic pain, severe dyspareunia, and a history of cesarean section are significant risk factors for persistent noncyclical pelvic pain despite hormonal treatment.
mod_finding: A previous cesarean section was identified as a significant risk factor for persistent noncyclical pelvic pain despite hormonal treatment.
